gist.summary: Added microsoft/mai-transcribe-2-streaming to /realtime and /v1/realtime for live transcription of mono 16 or 24 kHz PCM audio with manual commits. It uses Azure without a compatible fallback; Vercel uses a different streaming transport. Quest and Paid access is supported, with per-audio-hour billing based on Azure-reported duration rather than estimated input duration. The Azure deployment is configured for version 2026-08-06 on GlobalStandard capacity of 10 requests per minute, with automatic upgrades to new defaults. Azure lists December 4 as the model's retirement date and names no successor.
